strings.(데보라 설원의 한적한 장소에서 어울리지 않는 복장의 두 남자가 옷에 묻: (In a quiet corner of Deborah Snowfield, two men in conspicuously unsuitable clothes brush the snow from themselves.)
strings.이 대륙에서 뱀의 흔적은 더는 없는 것 같다. 레테를 만났던 때가 마지막: There seems to be no trace of the serpent left on this continent. To think our encounter with Lethe was the last...
The serpent is crafty. It must have crawled into hiding somewhere.
How you felt, watching that child's beginning, end, and new beginning...
The child who became master of this world...
strings.세레스 여신이 만들었던 데르 족의 피가 옅어지면서 후손들은 일반적인 인간: As the blood of the Tyr people created by Goddess Seres grew thin, their descendants lived as ordinary humans.
strings.각성하는 경우는 드물었지만 그래도 우리가 데르의 피가 섞인 자들을 쫓아: Awakenings were rare, but we still hunted down and killed those with Tyr blood, didn't we?
strings.그러고 보니 문득 그 녀석도 떠오르는군. 헤헤, 웃으며 신인줄도 모르고: That reminds me of someone else. Hehe. Following a mage around with a smile, unaware of being a god...
In any case, you're still denying what you are. The state you're in now is all because...
strings.할 수 없다는 걸 왜 모르지?: Why can't you understand that you can't?
strings.(카즈노가 계속되는 기침 끝에 정신을 잃고 눈밭으로 쓰러진다.): (After a prolonged coughing fit, Kazno loses consciousness and collapses into the snow.)
strings.그 아이를 위해서 하던 일을 접어야 네가 살 수 있텐데. 죽음마저 버틸: You could live if you stopped everything you're doing for that child. What does that child mean to you, that you would endure even death?
strings.뱀을 쫓자고 한 것도, 장난치던 마녀를 밖으로 끌어낸 것도, 그 자가 우: Suggesting we hunt the serpent, dragging that meddling witch out of hiding, revealing that one to be a being like us... All of it...
Everything you did for that child, Kazno...
strings.그런데 너는 언제부터 여기에 있었지?: And how long have you been here?
strings.(제릴이 카즈노를 부축하던 중, 어떤 소녀와 눈이 마주친다. 제릴이 미소: (While supporting Kazno, Jeril catches a girl's eye. As he smiles at her, she steps back in confusion.)
strings.(서로 다른 색의 눈동자…. 갑옷…. 어디선가 본 것 같은데….): (Eyes of different colors... That armor... I feel I've seen her somewhere...)
No need to be afraid. Just tell me who you are and where you came from.
strings.내가 왜 여기에 있는 거지? 너희는 누구지?: Why am I here? Who are you people?
I have no idea what you're talking about.
strings.바이스도 찾지 못하게 숨었는데, 어떻게 나를 찾은 거지?: I hid so well even Weiss couldn't find me. How did you do it?
Wait, why am I in Eastland? I was in Glaston a moment ago...
strings.바이스? 죄인을 피해 도망다니다니 보통이 아니군. 아가슈라도 아닌 것 같: Weiss? Staying on the run from the sinner is no small feat. Yet you don't seem to be an Agasura...
strings.날 아가슈라와 비교해? 그러지 마, 제발. 후우…. 이 땅의 새로운 신이: You're comparing me to an Agasura? Please don't. Honestly... I thought things would be easier once this land had a new god...
Let's not meet again, wolf boy. No, old man.
strings.(소녀가 주위를 살펴보다 서둘러 눈길을 따라 뛰어간다.): (The girl glances around and hurries away along the snowy path.)
strings.가뿐하게 무시당하다니…. 아가슈라 티 내는 건 별로 좋아하지 않지만, 어: Dismissed just like that... I don't like showing off my Agasura nature, but I suppose I have no choice.
Allow me to give you a gift.
strings.(제릴의 나지막한 중얼거림이 소녀의 귓가에 닿는다. 소녀는 순간 몸이 움: (Jeril's low murmur reaches the girl's ears. For an instant, she feels her body seize up, but she merely smiles.)
You're an Agasura? I don't want to get involved, so let's leave it at that.
strings.(소녀가 가뿐하게 기지개를 켜자 제릴이 피식 웃는다.): (The girl stretches with ease, and Jeril gives a wry smile.)
strings.훗, 재미있군. 결코 가볍지 않았을텐데, 그걸 깨고 움직이는 걸 보니 보: Hah. Interesting. That was no trifling spell, yet you broke it and moved. You're quite something. In that case...
No. I'll let you go. If that's what you are, we're bound to meet again.
strings.(제릴이 뭐라할 틈도 없이 소녀가 저 멀리 눈보라 사이로 사라지자 제자리: (Before Jeril can say another word, the girl vanishes into the distant blizzard. He stands there and begins laughing wildly.)
strings.(카즈노가 정신을 차려 제릴을 올려다보자 제릴이 환한 미소로 눈을 맞춘다: (Kazno regains consciousness and looks up at Jeril, who meets his eyes with a brilliant smile.)
Rejoice, Kazno. We've found bait for Ouroboros to swallow.
